# FG-AUTH-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`user-offboarding`](../../ops/runbooks/user-offboarding.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `disabling_the_last_active_human_admin_is_administration_conflict` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 管理者またはグループの Owner がいなくなるため、この操作は拒否されました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: This was refused because it would leave no administrator or group Owner. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Tindakan ini ditolak karena akan membuat tidak ada administrator atau Owner grup. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

An administration command was refused to keep forge manageable (ADR-0019 §10, Amendment D3 MR2). forge_db::users::disable refuses to disable the last active human administrator (bots, service accounts and disabled users do not count) or the last direct active Owner of a top-level group (subgroups inherit their ancestors' Owners and are not checked), or the only active Owner of a project, direct or inherited (D4 MR4; projects pending deletion are not checked); a refused disable writes nothing and revokes no token. forge_db::users::bootstrap_admin (forge admin bootstrap-admin) is refused while an active human administrator exists, and for a user that is not a human or is disabled.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`: last_admin (with `user`, the user id being disabled), last_owner (with `user`, `group_id` — the first top-level group that would be left without a direct active Owner — or, when no group is affected, `project_id` — the first project that would be left without an active Owner — and `ownerless_groups` and `ownerless_projects`, how many), admin_exists (with `active_human_admins`), not_human or user_disabled (with `user` when promoting an existing user; `bootstrap-admin --create` refuses before any user exists, so it carries no `user`). Ids only, never names. List the group's direct owners with a privileged query on forge.group_members joined to forge.users (role = 'owner' AND state = 'active'); list the administrators with SELECT id, kind, state FROM forge.users WHERE is_admin.

## 対処 (fix)

There is no command yet to grant administrator rights or change group members (D3), so the guard cannot be satisfied by adding a successor first. For last_admin / last_owner follow runbook user-offboarding: with approval naming the successor, disable with `forge admin user disable <username> --force`, then at once restore an administrator with `forge admin bootstrap-admin --user <successor>` (or `--create`); top-level groups left without an Owner stay reported by forge doctor (FG-AUTH-0010) until a member-change route exists. For admin_exists: bootstrap-admin is only for a forge without an active human administrator. For not_human / user_disabled: name an active human, or use --create.
